name: UCAS: dates and deadlines for undergraduate applications

extractionHints.shape: Not crawled. The dates are checked by hand each cycle and set in lib/deadlines/national.ts; npm run deadlines:national applies them. Status stays PAUSED.

notes: UCAS's national application calendar for undergraduate study in the UK, applied by rule to full-time UK undergraduate courses: the equal consideration date, the last date before Clearing, and the earlier date for Oxford, Cambridge, medicine, dentistry and veterinary courses.
